from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """
    Captures the key legal metadata from a single judgment document
    needed to determine its classification category.
    """
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="Type of legal document, e.g., '民事二审判决书', '行政二审裁定书', '执行复议裁定书'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="Explicit cause of action stated in the document, e.g., '继承纠纷', '离婚纠纷', '行政诉讼'")
    subject_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Key subject matter keywords identified in the text, e.g., '拆迁', '征收', '执行', '继承', '相邻关系'")
    core_dispute_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the core dispute or facts, e.g., '强拆房屋', '继承份额分配', '债权转让'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed documents for downstream classification."""
    documents: list[Document]
